given_when_then.given: The Store Partner is associated with an agreement marked as 'Active'
given_when_then.when: The Platform Operator or the Store Partner attempts to view the agreement details
given_when_then.then: The system allows access to view all versions, including historical ones

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner is not associated with an active agreement
given_when_then.when: The Store Partner attempts to view or edit any agreement version
given_when_then.then: The system denies access to the agreement details

given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator attempts to edit an agreement version
given_when_then.when: The system processes the edit request
given_when_then.then: The system grants permission to edit the agreement version

given_when_then.given: An actor who is neither the Platform Operator nor the associated Store Partner
given_when_then.when: The actor attempts to view or edit an agreement version
given_when_then.then: The system denies access to the agreement version

success_criteria: The system correctly restricts view and edit access to only the Platform Operator and the associated Store Partner.
The system grants access to all actors with valid authorization for the specific agreement version.
The system denies access to any actor without valid authorization for the specific agreement version.
